'''''Aftermath''''' is a [[canon]] novel by [[Chuck Wendig]]<ref name="Random House" /> and published by [[Del Rey]], that is set between [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The novel is the first in ''[[Star Wars: The Aftermath Trilogy]]'', and is part of the [[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']] publishing project. ''Aftermath'' sees the beginnings of a new government in the wake of the Empire's losses during the [[Battle of Endor]], and features at least one fan favorite character from the ''[[Star Wars]]'' films.<ref name="After Endor">{{SW|url=news/what-happened-after-endor-find-out-in-star-wars-aftermath|text=What Happened After Endor? Find Out in ''Star Wars: Aftermath''}}</ref> It was released on [[September 4]], [[2015]].<ref name="JourneyAnnounce" /> The audio edition is performed by [[Marc Thompson]].<ref name="audio">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/7846/aftermath-star-wars-by-chuck-wendig/9780399565229|text=Aftermath (Star Wars)}}</ref>
